Description

What Guests Love

• 2 Free Bikes will be provided
• Access to ALL Rosemary Beach Pools
• High-Speed Wireless Internet
• Washer/Dryer inside
• Flat Screen TV
• Queen Bed
• Bunk Bed (2 Twins)
• Tub Shower
• Outdoor Gas Grill
• Private Garage for One Vehicle, Shared with Cottage

The PTO Carriage House is a quiet & comfy option in the iconic town of Rosemary Beach. Rosemary Beach quickly became the premier beach vacation destination of the South and it’s not hard to see why. The PTO Carriage House is a short 4 minute walk or 1-2 minute bike ride to the beach and only 1-2 minutes to the Sky Pool or Cabana Pool. Prefer to shop and dine? Walk 3 minutes to arrive at Barrett Square & Main Street, where you’ll find all the shopping and dining of Rosemary Beach.

The PTO Carriage House features one bedroom with QUEEN bed, a bunk room just off the bedroom with TWO TWIN beds and spacious living room and a fully equipped kitchen with a dining table for four. There’s also a full bath located on the first floor. The living room offers a flat screen TV and sectional couch for your entertainment and relaxation

Reserved parking for one vehicle will be provided with this carriage house, as well as two complimentary rental bikes. Don’t miss the chance to experience Rosemary Beach at the PTO Carriage House, perfect for small families or a romantic couple’s getaway!

The PTO Carriage House also has a 3 bedroom PTO Cottage that can be rented with it and you'll receive a 25% discount on the Carriage House.

TDT-023856
